data.description:
Red Bull Through My Eyes provides a creative outlet for athletes to tell their stories using visual media from the 1st person perspective. Throughlocal gallery installations, fans are able to to view the world “through the eyes” of professional athletes. 

The first Red Bull Through My Eyes installation of 2011 will highlight photography shot by BMX street rider Edwin De La Rosa in New York City using his point and shoot Contax T2. Last January, the first Red Bull Through My Eyes installation featured pro-skateboarder Zered Bassett’s photos of his visit to Cuba. The images were met with rave reviews at Mountain Creek’s South Lodge in Vernon, NJ and the opening reception was covered by media outlets nationally. 

Edwin De La Rosa’s show will be the first Red Bull Through My Eyes installation in NYC.  

Gallery Opening Reception:
Thursday, January 13th  	8pm – 3am (open bar 8pm -10pm)

Exhibition:
Tuesday, January 11th – Tuesday, January 27th  	call for hours – 212.529.2266
data.location: Gallery Bar NYC,120 Orchard Street,New York,New York,United States
data.name: Edwin De La Rosa Photo Exhibit Red Bull Through My Eyes

data.description:
EDIT: No Lol Day was actually originally set to be a whole week, so to prevent any further confusion, I have changed the name and it DOES continue until the 22nd.

On these days, the word "LOL" should not be used by all participants. I have found it is actually very awkward having an IM or text convo without saying "lol" and I think everyone should see if they can get through at least a day without saying "lol" or at least cutting down on it and just saying "haha."

Also, lmao, rofl, etc. should not be used. The only indication that you are laughing should be the pure comedy in the conversation. If you're both laughing, you don't need to tell each other.

Also, try not to say "lol" on this page at all...it'll be like practice XD
data.name: No Lol Week

data.description:
In partnership with City of New York Parks and Recreation and Prospect Park Alliance, Red Bull is bringing snowboarding to Winter Jam NYC with Red Bull Butter Cup, an open snowboarding event that showcases technical trickery and fun! Red Bull will be setting up their custom butter pads for snowboarders to session in attempt to win tons of prizes.

Red Bull Butter Cup is a contest series that showcases creativity in technical flatland trickery. Cut loose and spread it on at Loon in order to win tons of cash and prizes.

Born in the northeast in 2009 and bred for the country in 2011, it's all about going back to the basics of what made us all fall in love with shredding in the first place: FUN! Butter up and cut loose on the custom Red Bull butter pads and bring your bag of tricks.

Style and creativity is the name of the game and the competition is hot so the cream will rise to the top. The jam session format keeps the action flowing while riders battle in Pro and Am divisions for cash and fresh gear. Only trick sequences that include buttering will count so hit the snow and start polishing your skills.

Info:
Prospect Park, Brooklyn NY in the Nethermead Area
Registration is Free
Open to first 80 riders- AM and PRO
To Pre-Register go to: www.nyc.gov/parks

PRO Winner: 1 Week Scholarship to Woodward Camp
AM Winner: Forum Snowboard

Tons of other prizes from sponsors - Forum, Neff, Nike 6.0, Oakley and Snowboarder Magazine

for more: http://www.redbullusa.com/buttercup

Like NYC Parks! http://www.facebook.com/nycparks
data.location: Prospect Park, Brooklyn NY in the Nethermead Area
data.name: Red Bull Butter Cup - NYC Winter Jam

Featuring
PAULY CRUSH
(Crush / Pulp / Saturday/Thursday)
http://www.facebook.com/paulycrush

Pauly has thrown down mixes with many influential deejays in the genre including Justice, Mstrkrft, Diplo, DJ Medhi, Riot In Belgium, Digitalism, Nick Catchdubs, Pase Rock, Felix Cartal, DJ Funk, Kid Cudi, A.C. Slater, Crookers, Orgasmic, Para One, Steve Aoki, Curses, Surkin, A-Trak, Clever, Drop the Lime, Franki Chan, Toxic Avenger, Gui Borrato, Jesse Rose, Pace Rock, Lazaro Casanova, Tittsworth, Aaron Lacrate, Flosstradamus, Kid Sister, Jubilee & Udachi, Designer Drugs, Villains and dozens more. 

Pauly Crush has credits on a handful of indie and major release records as Paul Geller and Pauly Jett; writing and production credits for many hardcore and indie bands and has produced authorized and unauthorized remixes/edits/blends of and using artists including Justice, Lady Sovereign, Aaliyah, Dr. Dre, Simian Mobile Disco, The Ting Tings and Miley Cyrus. Pauly is the only remaining founding member of CRUSH and is also credited with founding Club Firestone’s legendary “Saturday / Thursday” party, PULP @ Czar in Tampa and a handful of other Florida events that have broken down barriers for this scene.
